# Financial Data Extractor

> Open-source platform to automatically extract, normalize, and compile 10 years of financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) from European company annual reports using LLM-powered PDF parsing.

The Financial Data Extractor automates the labor-intensive process of collecting and standardizing financial data from investor relations websites. It uses Crawl4AI for web scraping, OpenRouter for LLM-powered extraction, and a modern FastAPI + Celery + PostgreSQL stack for processing and storage.

## Key Facts

- License: Apache 2.0
- Author: Patryk Golabek
- Source: https://github.com/PatrykQuantumNomad/financial-data-extractor
- Documentation: https://financial-data-extractor.patrykgolabek.dev

## Target Companies

Initial scope covers 6 European companies: AstraZeneca PLC, SAP SE, Siemens AG, ASML Holding N.V., Unilever PLC, Allianz SE. The architecture supports adding more companies dynamically via API.

## Technology Stack

- Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI, Celery, SQLAlchemy, Alembic
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 (JSONB), Redis 8
- PDF Processing: PyMuPDF, camelot-py, pdfplumber
- Web Scraping: Crawl4AI with LLM extraction strategy
- LLM: OpenRouter API gateway (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Claude)
- Storage: MinIO (S3-compatible)
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Flower
